subject.title: [Feature]: Discord: Re-process edited user messages (MESSAGE_UPDATE event)

question: Should Discord edited-message reprocessing land as default-on behavior in the broader edit/delete PR, as an opt-in edit-only feature, or be split from delete-to-cancel?
rationale: Current source proves the missing edit path, but the issue proposes opt-in edit handling while the open PR proposes default-on edit and delete behavior, which is a product and upgrade-semantics choice.

options.title: Settle semantics in the linked PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92091 or a narrow replacement as the decision point, requiring live Discord proof and explicit default/config behavior before merge.

options.title: Require opt-in edit config
options.body: Implement handleEdits and edit debounce as disabled-by-default Discord config, matching this issue's compatibility proposal but adding configuration surface.

options.title: Split delete-to-cancel
options.body: Land edit-to-reprocess separately and keep delete-to-cancel on the broader lifecycle tracker if cancellation semantics are not ready.

recommendation.title: Settle semantics in the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92091 or a narrow replacement as the decision point, requiring live Discord proof and explicit default/config behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest prior review context and recent Discord monitor/startup history for deciding the product/default semantics.
